signals.controller_torque: MuJoCo actuator input (data.ctrl); units depend on actuator gear
signals.actuator_torque: MuJoCo data.qfrc_actuator; actual simulated generalized actuator force
signals.contact_wrench: wrist force/torque sensors, not isolated contact
signals.contact_force: tool-table normal contact load in N from MuJoCo contacts

note: Every row is a physics step, not a policy transition; null means unavailable.
